# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in QuizNova, please report it privately
via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting on this repository or email
`moamen.elbarky@gmail.com`.

Please do not report vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues or pull
requests.
